profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Litera
profile.summary:
​I am a Senior Software Developer and Consultant with over 7 years of experience building high-quality, highly scalable services and APIs for Fortune 500 clients. As a Team Lead, I bridge the gap between technical execution and client strategy—connecting complex backend datastores into seamless internal and external consumer endpoints, all backed by robust monitoring and alerting.

​Core Stack: Go, C# (.NET), Python, TypeScript, AWS, Azure, New Relic, SQL, and PostgreSQL.
Workflow Acceleration: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code.

positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

positions.title: Manager - Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Team Leadership · Go (Programming Language) · New Relic · Cloud-Native Architecture · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cloud Infrastructure · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Cloud Services · Object-oriented Languages · REST APIs · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Senior Consultant- Developer
positions.description: Skills: Azure Key Vault · Azure Functions · New Relic · C# · Cloud-Native Architecture · .NET Framework · Microsoft SQL Server · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Microsoft Azure · .NET Core · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Cloud Services · TypeScript · Object-oriented Languages · REST APIs · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description: Architected and delivered bespoke GO APIs within AWS Fargate and Lambda to facilitate a massive backend migration, directly managing the secure flow of sensitive customer data. Implemented high-throughput event-driven messaging by publishing to Kafka queues, ensuring near real-time data consistency between legacy databases and modern cloud environments. Acted as the primary technical point of contact for client stakeholders, translating complex business requirements into high-performance engineering deliverables. Owned the end-to-end integration lifecycle, ensuring new services maintained high code consistency and seamless interoperability with the client's legacy infrastructure, including unit & integration testing with up/down-stream services. Developed custom automation and validation tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot integrations) that reduced deployment friction and ensured bug-free production releases for the client. Formalized technical strategy and mentored peer engineers on-site to maintain delivery velocity and upskill the client's internal development team.

positions.title: Retail Systems Development Intern
positions.description: Developing the Retail System's web-apps using angular JS, specifically working in the Personal Advisory Service division

positions.title: Segway Tour Guide
positions.description:
-Instructed guests how to ride Segways and conducted tours across Camelback Mt. in the Poconos
-Utilized strong communication skills in providing tours to as many as five groups per day

positions.title: Ski Instructor
positions.description:
-Taught levels beginner to advanced, ages 3-adult
-Developed teaching ability, patience, and communication skills in teaching people of all ages and skill levels
